requirement:
调整支付流程和订票保存服务的代码细节。
支付服务和订票服务之间的数据传递需要优化。
需要检查支付完成后通知订单的逻辑。

details.name: ts-inside-payment-service
details.rationale: Handles internal payment processing and likely interacts with ts-payment-service for payment completion.

details.name: ts-order-service
details.rationale: Order service receives payment notifications and updates order status, so changes to payment flow affect it.

details.name: ts-order-other-service
details.rationale: Similar to ts-order-service, handles other order types and may need updates for payment notification logic.

details.name: ts-preserve-service
details.rationale: Ticket reservation service likely triggers payment and needs to align with optimized payment data flow.

details.name: ts-preserve-other-service
details.rationale: Handles other reservation types and may interact with payment service for booking confirmation.

details.name: ts-cancel-service
details.rationale: Cancellation may involve payment refunds, so payment flow changes could affect this service.

details.name: ts-rebook-service
details.rationale: Rebooking may require payment adjustments, so it could be impacted by payment service changes.

details.name: ts-notification-service
details.rationale: May send payment-related notifications to users, so logic changes in payment flow could affect it.

details.name: ts-wait-order-service
details.rationale: Handles waiting orders that may involve payment status, so it could be affected by payment flow changes.
